## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Only an optional correction was found: `test_rejects_legacy_header` passes without testing the new version check. `test_rejects_unsupported_header_with_complete_report` still covers that branch.

## Changes
`parse_report` now accepts only the exact header `REPORT v1` and no longer accepts any line starting with `REPORT `. The pull request also adds two tests that check unsupported reports are rejected.

## Suggestions
- tests/test_report.py:11 — tests — Make the legacy-header test change the header — `"v0".join(fixture.rsplit("v1", 1))` changes only the last `v1`, so the input becomes `"REPORT v1\nversion=v0"`. That input keeps the v1 header and has no `END` line. `parse_report` returns `None` because `END` is missing (`app/report.py:3`), so the test also passes on the old `startswith("REPORT ")` code. The comment at line 9 says the test changes "the fixture's version to v0", but the header is unchanged. — This test does not protect the version check it is named for, and its comment misdescribes the input. — Fix: Use a complete legacy report such as `"REPORT v0\nvalue=ok\nEND"` with a distinct legacy header, or delete the test because `test_rejects_unsupported_header_with_complete_report` already covers this case.
